command:
$root = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '.').Path
$buildDirectory = Join-Path $root 'out\build\windows-msvc-x64'
$targets = @(
    'ForgeConductor.Telemetry.WindowsTests',
    'ForgeConductor.Domain.UnitTests',
    'ForgeConductor.Dashboard.TelemetryJsonCodecTests',
    'ForgeConductor.Dashboard.TelemetrySourceTests',
    'ForgeConductor.Dashboard.ConnectionApplicationTests',
    'ForgeConductor.Manager.DoctorServiceTests',
    'ForgeConductor.Contracts.ContractTests'
)
& cmake --build $buildDirectory --config Release --target $targets -- /m
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Release build failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }

$testPattern = '^(ForgeConductor\.Telemetry\.WindowsTests|ForgeConductor\.Domain\.UnitTests|ForgeConductor\.Dashboard\.TelemetryJsonCodecTests|ForgeConductor\.Dashboard\.TelemetrySourceTests|ForgeConductor\.Dashboard\.ConnectionApplicationTests|ForgeConductor\.Manager\.DoctorServiceTests|ForgeConductor\.Contracts\.ContractTests)$'
& ctest --test-dir $buildDirectory -C Release --output-on-failure -V -R $testPattern
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Focused Release tests failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }

$typeperf = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\typeperf.exe'
$typeperfOutput = @(& $typeperf -q '\Memory' 2>&1)
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "The current-machine PDH inventory probe failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }
$compressedCounter = '\Memory\Compressed Page Count'
$compressedMatches = @($typeperfOutput | Where-Object { ([string]$_).Trim() -ceq $compressedCounter }).Count
if ($compressedMatches -ne 0) { throw "The qualified-machine PDH inventory unexpectedly contains $compressedCounter." }
Write-Output "QUALIFIED_MACHINE_PDH_COMPRESSED_PAGE_COUNT_MATCHES=$compressedMatches"

$g04Path = Join-Path $root 'scripts\validation\Test-G04BuildScaffold.ps1'
$g04Text = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $g04Path
$g04BuildMarker = '$buildScript ='
$g04BuildIndex = $g04Text.IndexOf($g04BuildMarker, [StringComparison]::Ordinal)
if ($g04BuildIndex -lt 0) { throw 'The G04 static-prefix boundary marker was not found.' }
$g04StaticPrefix = $g04Text.Substring(0, $g04BuildIndex)
& ([scriptblock]::Create($g04StaticPrefix)) -WorkspaceRoot $root -Parallel 1
Write-Output 'G04_STATIC_PREFIX_PASSED'

& (Join-Path $root '.forge-codex\instructions\scripts\Validate-NoPython.ps1') -WorkspaceRoot $root
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'The no-Python policy check failed.' }
& (Join-Path $root '.forge-codex\instructions\scripts\Validate-NoAttribution.ps1') -WorkspaceRoot $root
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'The no-attribution policy check failed.' }
& (Join-Path $root '.forge-codex\instructions\scripts\Verify-Ledger.ps1') -WorkspaceRoot $root
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Ledger verification failed.' }
& git diff --check
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git diff --check failed.' }

$artifacts = @(
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/bin/Release/ForgeConductor.Telemetry.WindowsTests.exe',
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/bin/Release/ForgeConductor.Domain.UnitTests.exe',
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/bin/Release/ForgeConductor.Dashboard.TelemetryJsonCodecTests.exe',
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/bin/Release/ForgeConductor.Dashboard.TelemetrySourceTests.exe',
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/bin/Release/ForgeConductor.Dashboard.ConnectionApplicationTests.exe',
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/bin/Release/ForgeConductor.Manager.DoctorServiceTests.exe',
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/bin/Release/ForgeConductor.Contracts.ContractTests.exe',
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/lib/Release/ForgeConductor.Telemetry.Windows.lib',
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/lib/Release/ForgeConductor.Domain.lib'
)
foreach ($relativePath in $artifacts) {
    $artifactPath = Join-Path $root $relativePath.Replace('/', '\')
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $artifactPath -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Missing expected artifact: $relativePath" }
    $hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $artifactPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
    $length = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $artifactPath).Length
    Write-Output "ARTIFACT_SHA256=$hash BYTES=$length PATH=$relativePath"
}
